Основной формат нового authoring — полный C2 source. `legacy/v1-json` — только
совместимость и history.

Current authoring: one Project has one full C2 source with multiple funnel sections.
Do not require independent Funnel source versions or attachments for new Projects.
See docs/authoring/c2/LANGUAGE.md and examples/multi-funnel-routing.c2.
